name: Laszlo Kovacs
bio:
Laszlo's journey in motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his family's auto repair shop. This hands-on experience fueled a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, he spent several years as a race engineer for smaller Hungarian teams, honing his technical skills and developing a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. His meticulous approach and talent for problem-solving quickly gained him recognition.

His career took a significant leap when he joined Team WRT, initially as the lead engineer. His ability to effectively manage technical teams and translate complex data into actionable strategies propelled him into the role of team principal. Laszlo emphasizes a collaborative environment, believing that open communication and mutual respect are essential for success. He is known for his calm demeanor under pressure and his unwavering commitment to his team's goals. What sets him apart is his talent to visualize the big picture, enabling him to take necessary risks and make strategic decisions that set his team up for success.

physical.description: Laszlo has a sturdy build with a serious but kind face that is etched with the wisdom of experience.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out slide rule in his pocket, even though he uses computer software.
Prefers strong black coffee and drinks at least five cups a day.
Has a habit of tapping his pen on the table when deep in thought.
